about: Pet Shelf queue, Thu 19 - Wed 25 Nov 2026. Status 'preview' = made and waiting for boss; the robot only books 'approved'. Boss rule: no reply by 08:00 = posts go out.

posts.brief: Snuffle mat for sniffing out treats
posts.caption:
Eats too fast?
This snuffle mat for sniffing out treats: hide food in the fabric so your dog sniffs it out.
Good for: slowing down meals, rainy-day play. Not for: dogs that chew and swallow fabric, so watch them.

posts.brief: Quiet hamster exercise wheel (11 inch)
posts.caption:
Swipe through 👉 Noisy wheel at night?
Larger quiet wheel for a straight running position.
Good for larger hamsters, quiet nights.

posts.brief: Quick-dry microfibre dog towel and Dog paw cleaner cup (medium)
posts.caption: Wet walk? A thick towel soaks up the water, and a paw cup cleans muddy feet at the door.

posts.brief: Light-up dog collar for night walks
posts.caption:
Hard to see your dog on night walks?
This collar glows, so cars and people can see your dog.
Keep the ID tag collar on too.

posts.brief: Snuffle mat for sniffing out treats and Treat puzzle toy with sliding blocks
posts.caption: Two ways to keep a clever dog busy: a mat to sniff out food, and a puzzle with hidden treats. Stay close if your dog chews things.

posts.brief: Magnetic aquarium glass cleaner
posts.caption:
Green tank glass?
This magnetic aquarium glass cleaner: magnet cleaner wipes the glass with dry hands.
Good for: algae on glass. Not for: glass thicker than its rating, so check first.

posts.brief: Rechargeable light-up dog collar
posts.caption:
Swipe through 👉 Dark walks?
A glowing collar that cars and people can see.
Good for evening and early-morning walks.

posts.brief: Quiet hamster exercise wheel, 11 inch
posts.caption:
Is the hamster wheel too noisy at night?
This bigger wheel is made to run quietly, with room to run straight.
Check that your cage fits 11 inches.

posts.brief: Deshedding brush with a wavy blade
posts.caption:
Swipe through 👉 Fur everywhere?
A wavy blade pulls out loose fur as you brush.
Good for dogs that shed a lot.

posts.brief: Natural wood bird play stand
posts.caption:
Bored in the cage?
This natural wood bird play stand: wooden stand for play on a table.
Good for: small birds like budgies and cockatiels. Not for: large parrots, since it is small.

posts.brief: Rechargeable light-up dog collar and No-pull reflective dog harness
posts.caption: For dark evenings: a collar that lights up and a harness with reflective strips, so your dog is easier to see.

posts.brief: Snuffle mat for dogs that eat too fast
posts.caption:
Does your dog eat too fast?
Hide the food in this mat, and your dog sniffs it out.
Stay close if your dog chews fabric.

posts.brief: 30 ft long training lead
posts.caption:
Practising recall?
This 30 ft long training lead: a very long lead so your dog can roam while still attached.
Good for: recall training, parks, beaches. Not for: busy streets, where a short lead is safer.

posts.brief: Oversize rabbit litter box with drawer and Hanging wooden hay feeder
posts.caption: A big litter box with a pull-out drawer, and a rack that keeps hay off the floor. Measure your cage first.

posts.brief: Treat puzzle toy with sliding blocks
posts.caption:
Swipe through 👉 Bored dog at home?
Slide and lift the blocks to find hidden treats.
Good for smart dogs, alone time with a bit of food.

posts.brief: Dog deshedding brush with a wavy blade
posts.caption:
Dog fur all over the house?
This brush has a wavy blade that pulls out loose fur.
Not for sore or broken skin.

posts.brief: Quick-dry microfibre dog towel
posts.caption:
Swipe through 👉 Wet dog again?
A thick microfibre towel that soaks up water fast.
Good for after baths, rain and beach days.

posts.brief: No-drip small pet water bottle (32 oz)
posts.caption:
Wet bedding again?
This no-drip small pet water bottle (32 oz): hanging bottle with a no-drip nozzle.
Good for: small pets, cages with bars. Not for: pets that need a smaller bottle, so check the size.

posts.brief: Magnetic aquarium glass cleaner and Aquarium siphon gravel cleaner (5 ft)
posts.caption: A magnet cleaner for algae on the glass, and a hand siphon for water changes and gravel.

posts.brief: Dog treat puzzle toy with sliding blocks
posts.caption:
Bored dog at home?
Hide treats in this puzzle, and your dog slides the blocks to find them.
Stay with strong chewers.

posts.brief: Expandable cat backpack carrier
posts.caption:
Vet trip stress?
This expandable cat backpack carrier: soft backpack carrier that expands.
Good for: vet trips, short travel. Not for: anyone flying, until you check your airline's size rules.

posts.brief: Bird cage seed catcher skirt
posts.caption:
Swipe through 👉 Seed on the floor?
Mesh skirt around the cage catches the mess.
Good for seed eaters, tidier floors.

posts.brief: Natural wood bird play stand and Fold-away bird shower and window perch
posts.caption: A small wooden stand for play on a table, and a perch that holds on the shower wall or window. Always stay with your bird.

posts.brief: Magnetic aquarium glass cleaner
posts.caption:
Green algae on the tank glass?
This magnet cleaner wipes the inside, while your hands stay dry.
Check your glass thickness first.

posts.brief: Retractable cat wand with feather refills and Suction-cup cat window hammock
posts.caption: A feather wand for playtime, and a window seat for watching the world. Check your window size first.

posts.brief: Betta leaf hammock (3-pack)
posts.caption:
Betta needs a rest?
This betta leaf hammock (3-pack): leaf-shaped hammock with a suction cup.
Good for: betta tanks. Not for: tanks with very strong flow, so check placement.

posts.brief: Oversize rabbit litter box with drawer
posts.caption:
Swipe through 👉 Messy cage corner?
A big litter box with a pull-out drawer for easy cleaning.
Good for rabbits, guinea pigs.

posts.brief: Double-layer cat litter mat
posts.caption:
Litter all over the floor?
This mat has two layers, so litter from the paws falls inside.
It catches most, not every grain.
